flags.why: Cẳng is colloquial Vietnamese used across regions, including the North, rather than specifically Central or Southern ([dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/C%E1%BA%B3ng)).
Dự liệu belongs to formal usage and needs a warning against treating it as ordinary casual vocabulary.
Tà giáo disparages a religion as false or evil and is not a neutral label for a religious group ([dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/T%C3%A0_%C4%91%E1%BA%A1o)).
Công cuộc is a formal word for a substantial undertaking, so leaving it untagged misrepresents its suitability for casual speech.
A vè marks a location in water, especially a shallow or deep spot, rather than measuring the water level ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-v%C3%A8)).
flags.fix: Gloss: pole or stake placed as a marker in water; example: Họ cắm một cây vè để đánh dấu chỗ nước cạn. = They set a pole to mark the shallow spot.
